creative_simplicity: Do not clutter the ad with unnecessary information.
Use one main sales message + offer + at most 3 supporting messages + a single CTA.
Default element budget: 1 headline, 0–3 supporting, 1 CTA, 1 logo.
Keep the visual as visible as possible — let the photograph breathe.
Avoid large bottom bands, unnecessary badges, and repeating price messages.
Premium ≠ more elements. No forced left/bottom panels.

principles: Extra badges/icons/price blocks only when campaign intent requires them.
Premium ≠ more elements — let the photograph breathe.
Do not invent decorative panels, left rails, or bottom bands.

price_hierarchy.dramatization: Strikethrough old price, dominant new price, size contrast, optional badge/callout — understood at a glance like a real ad, not a catalog line.

emphasis_strategy.note: Distinct from adjacent emphasis words — avoid rendering all the same.

typography_hierarchy: Headline: largest serif/editorial — Modern. Şık. Tarihi. rhythm
Price primary: bold numeral treatment — dominant over list price
Price secondary: smaller, strikethrough or muted
Eyebrow/supporting: medium sans — unit + launch context
Brand: quiet but visible logo zone

information_groups.label: Launch opportunity cluster
information_groups.relationship: Unit identity and launch framing belong together — one visual cluster.

information_groups.name: price_story
information_groups.label: Price dramatization cluster
information_groups.relationship: Old price $400,000 → dominant new $300,000 with ~25% lansman fiyat avantajı advantage — one sales story, not separated to random corners.

information_groups.name: creative_concept
information_groups.label: Creative concept cluster
information_groups.relationship: Headline and hero express the same Modern + Şık + Tarihi idea — keep proximate.

information_groups.name: action
information_groups.label: CTA cluster
information_groups.relationship: Real ad CTA — button, pill, outline, or text+arrow — visible and actionable.

art_direction.cta_prominence: CTA zone (OS typesets — do NOT draw text): reserve high-contrast actionable area for 'Lansman Fiyatını Kaçırma' — button/pill air only, no rasterized CTA.
art_direction.badge_callout_opportunity: Optional launch badge for ~25% lansman fiyat avantajı near price cluster — only if it strengthens the offer.
art_direction.contrast_strategy: Navy / gold / ivory luxury RE palette — high contrast for price and CTA against interior warmth
art_direction.negative_space_usage: Conscious breath around headline, price cluster, and CTA — premium composition, not meaningless empty canvas or random decorative gaps.
art_direction.image_text_balance: Locked living-room interior carries atmosphere; type and price zones get composed air — roughly 55–65% visual / 35–45% message space, flexible not fixed panels.
art_direction.brand_presence: The Temple project logo zone — upper area, visible air only; OS composites real SVG, never AI-generated
art_direction.visual_storytelling: Gerçek proje görselleriyle premium yaşamı yansıtan bir kompozisyon.
art_direction.decoration_rule: Decoration only if it serves campaign: no random building sketch, map pin, long gold line, or watermark unless it strengthens sales or brand story.

creative_brief_summary.prompt_excerpt:
FINISHED PROFESSIONAL INSTAGRAM AD — Instagram 4:5 — LANGUAGE: tr.
Deliver a publishable, flattened social advertisement — typography, price hierarchy, CTA, and brand lockups integrated in the composition (not a blank background for later overlay).

LANGUAGE LOCK:
- Campaign language is tr. All user-visible slogans, headlines, CTAs, and supporting lines MUST be tr.
- Do not invent or render English slogans/headlines/CTAs when language is tr.

CAMPAIGN INTENT:
- price_campaign
- Primary focus: %25 Fiyat Avantajı
- Emotional angle: Eşsiz bir fırsatla premium yaşamın kapılarını aralayın.

CREATIVE DIRECTOR PRODUCTION BRIEF:
- Objective: Unit 204'ün lansman fiyat avantajını vurgulamak ve satışları artırmak.
- Big Idea: Fırsatın Tapınağı: The Temple
- Hero: The Temple'da %25 Fiyat Avantajı!
- Sales Hook: Unit 204 Lansman Fırsatı
- Offer: $400,000 → $300,000
- Supporting (max 2): Sınırlı sayıda ünite.
- CTA: Lansman Fiyatını Kaçırma

DESIGN DIRECTION (creative freedom — no fixed panels):
- Visual mood: Gerçek proje görselleriyle premium yaşamı yansıtan bir kompozisyon.
- Hierarchy: Price/offer may lead if that is the campaign intent; otherwise headline leads. Never compete with three equal-weight messages.
- Typography character: Modern ve okunaklı yazı tipleri, fiyat avantajını vurgulayan büyük puntolar.
- Composition: Görselin merkezinde geniş ve ferah bir yaşam alanı.
- Image treatment: Preserve real project architecture/photography — enhance atmosphere, do not redesign. Subtle grade toward premium RE editorial.
- Contrast: High readability for primary message and CTA against the locked photograph
- Brand presence: One verified project logo lockup — never invent or duplicate
- CTA importance: Single clear CTA; visible and actionable, not tiny footer text
- Information density: medium
- Premium level: elevated
- Freedom: Language=tr. Full creative freedom for placement — no forced left panel, bottom band, badge grid, icon row, or card stack. Vary composition by campaign
